title: Euro 2024 Final: The Sub Winner
description:
How does a substitute win a final in under nineteen minutes? In the Euro 2024 final, Mikel Oyarzabal came on for Spain at 67:19 and scored the winner at 85:56, 18 minutes 37 seconds later. England's equaliser also came from a substitute: Cole Palmer, 2 minutes 15 seconds after coming on. Two of the three goals came from the bench. Event data is StatsBomb Open Data, not tracking data; the expected-goals value (0.28) is StatsBomb's model.

Full breakdown: on our channel, "How To Analyse a Football Match (Using the Euro 2024 Final)".

#Shorts #Euro2024 #Football #FootballTactics #Spain #England #RivalLines

Data: StatsBomb Open Data (https://github.com/statsbomb/open-data). StatsBomb logo shown as required by their terms.
Photos: Mikel Oyarzabal in 2018 (Giovanni Batista Rodriguez, CC BY-SA 2.0) and Cole Palmer in November 2024 (Truth619, CC0), both via Wikimedia Commons; neither is from the final.
